evidence.reason: At the current tip, the inspect evidence assigns `inspect["source"] = self.source` (line 2645), and the phase manifests are built from that same shared source object. `copy.deepcopy` preserves shared references, so mutating `broken["partial-inspect"]["source"]["guest"]` also mutates the shared prepare manifest. The assertion can therefore pass because of a prepare-source mismatch without proving the final inspect manifest was checked. The test should replace only the final `source` dictionary with a copied mapping containing the changed guest digest. This is a real, unrepaired test-isolation defect.
